Condos for Sale in Nai Yang, Phuket

6 development projects in Nai Yang
HomeLocationsNai Yang

Nai Yang at a glance

Our catalogue currently lists 6 development projects in Nai Yang: 6 condominiums. Advertised starting prices run from ฿2,900,000 to ฿4,960,000 (5 of 6 projects publish a price; the rest are on request). Ownership offered by the developers: freehold, so please confirm the exact title with your lawyer before buying.

About Nai Yang

Nai Yang is in the north-west of Phuket, in Thalang district, next to Nai Yang Beach and Sirinat National Park. Project descriptions place the airport only five to ten minutes away by car, which is the main practical difference from the southern and central west-coast areas.

All six projects listed here are condominiums, mostly from Rhom Bho Property (The Title) plus one project by The Zero, and several are pre-sale or under construction with units listed under the foreign quota.

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Mai Khao · Layan

  • Construction status in our catalogue: Pre-sale (1), Under construction (3), Completed (2).
